question: Emilia is contracted to ‘not disguise her nature from others’. In arc one, when she was able to use Satella as an alias to Subaru, was that some sort of foreshadowing? Silly child Emilia-tan is one thing, but it didn’t feel like Puck thought of it as breaking the contract, either.
answer: My apologies. I’ve restated that as being unable to disguise not her ‘nature’, but ‘the fact that she is a half-elf’.
